screens.name: Landing page
screens.description: Single-page bilingual marketing site — the full approved 13-band stack: sticky nav; dark hero (rotating H1, sub, two CTAs, 3D fitment scene with floating part/fit/video cards); proof bar (120M+ / 0% / 100,000+ / 2026); The problem (19.4% / 86% / 16.75–19.66% tiles + Senen market quote); How it works (3 steps + 'The same search, two outcomes' comparison); buyer strip; 'Fees went up. Trust didn't.' blue band; AI catalog showcase card (animated part sprites); Early Adaptors (3 benefit cards + Join Waitlist CTA); Team (3 founder cards); Investors panel (deck request + founder emails); Unify band (Indonesia flyover map); dark footer.
entry_points: Direct URL / marketing links / WhatsApp shares

screens.name: Join Waitlist page
screens.description: Split-screen seller waitlist wizard: dark brand panel (white logo, '0% platform fee · first 300 shops' chip, 'Be one of the first shops on Mobeeli.', 3 benefit rows, trust line, floating disc/plug sprites) + wizard card with progress bar and steps: intro → 1/4 business type (Store/Garage/Distributor) → 2/4 business name (type-adaptive label/placeholder) + contact name → 3/4 email/phone/WhatsApp/city (optional, format-validated) → 4/4 volume + tools (garage) or brands + Net-30 checkbox + message → submit.

screens.name: Waitlist success state
screens.description: Success panel replacing the wizard card: check badge, 'You're on the list.' headline, personalized body (business name interpolated), primary 'Chat on WhatsApp' CTA (prefilled wa.me deep link with business name + language-appropriate message), secondary 'Back to Mobeeli'.
